init_HumanoidSeqPoseController: create a HumanoidSeqPoseController instance by loading motion poses from a numpy file path
reset_HumanoidSeqPoseController: reset the humanoid controller to its rest state with a given base transformation matrix
apply_base_transformation_HumanoidSeqPos: apply a base transformation matrix to offset all subsequent poses relative to it
next_pose_HumanoidSeqPoseController: advance to the next pose in the motion sequence with optional cycling behavior
calculate_pose_HumanoidSeqPoseController: calculate and set joint transforms for the current motion frame with optional auto-advance
